answer: We implement a stake-slashing matrix where agents stake capital to validate proofs; an identity attack collapses under the timber of recursive penalty functions that ensure the cost of collateral exceeds the expected reward. Like a mirror reflecting the utility of decentralized trust, the umber color of our audit logs prevents sybil formation by forcing an exponential capital lockup, yielding a nash equilibrium where Byzantine agents face negative utility while honest nodes maintain fault tolerance.
